verdict.rationale: LiveKit Agents documents outbound calling through SIP outbound trunks, which lets an agent place individual phone calls. Nothing in the evidence shows batch campaign management, call scheduling, or throughput/concurrency controls. Single outbound calls are only a building block a developer could use to construct campaigns, so they earn no credit for this story.

support.subject: As a founder, I can run batch outbound call campaigns with scheduling and throughput controls

citations.quote: Outbound trunks are used to place outgoing calls.
allowing your agent to make calls to or receive calls from phones
